title: Quasi-hyperbolic discounting and retirement
abstract: FLAG: IDEAS lists this paper as having no abstract. Per publisher / MIT description: the paper adds endogenous retirement to the standard quasi-hyperbolic discounting savings model, showing that quasi-hyperbolic discounting can cause dynamic inconsistency in retirement timing as well as in consumption plans. Earlier selves think the deciding self tends to retire too early and may save less to induce later retirement, while still earlier selves may think the pre-retirement self does this too much, saving more to induce early retirement.
